summary: Re-tested EventCreate Pydantic model fix for recurring/recur_until/reminder_minutes fields. Main agent's fix (server.py lines 60-62) is verified WORKING. POST /api/events persists all 3 new fields (weekly + 2026-05-10 + 60), GET /api/events returns them, PUT /api/events/{id} updates them (daily + 2026-03-10 + 30), and defaults (none/empty/0) are applied when fields are omitted. Extended TestEventRecurring with 2 new tests (PUT update + defaults) - all 4 EventRecurring tests pass. Iteration-2 critical bug is fully resolved.

critical_code_review_comments: EventCreate model now correctly declares all 3 new optional fields with sane defaults (none/empty/0). Verified Pydantic v2 round-trips them through POST -> Mongo -> GET and PUT -> Mongo -> GET.
Frontend reminder poller can now reliably read reminder_minutes from /api/events response - end-to-end recurring + reminder feature is unblocked.

PUT /api/events/{id} uses payload.model_dump() which OVERWRITES all fields. If frontend sends a partial payload it will reset un-sent fields to defaults (recurring='none', etc.). Consider PATCH semantics or document that PUT requires full payload.
